user.title: Discovery Service
user.description: Enter the address of the Area Events Discovery Service and its tokens. The read token lets Home Assistant show events; the optional control token also lets administrators change shared discovery settings. {transport_note}

data_description.url: For example https://events.example:8780 (a TLS reverse proxy in front of the service) or http://localhost:8780 on the same computer.
data_description.read_token: Created by the service for read-only clients.
data_description.control_token: Leave empty to keep Home Assistant read-only. The token is stored only in Home Assistant's backend and is never sent to a dashboard.
data_description.ca_file: For an https address with a private (self-signed) certificate: the path of the certificate file on Home Assistant, for example /config/area_events_cert.pem.

reauth_confirm.title: Tokens rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Discovery Service rejected a token. Enter the current tokens.

error.cannot_connect: The Discovery Service could not be reached. Check that it is running and that the address is correct.
error.invalid_auth: The Discovery Service rejected the read token.
error.invalid_ca_file: The certificate file could not be read. Check the path and that it is a PEM certificate.
error.invalid_control_token: The Discovery Service does not allow that token to change settings.

abort.already_configured: This Discovery Service is already set up.

data.action: What would you like to configure?

data.scan_interval: Seconds between checks for new events

data_description.scan_interval: One check serves every card. Between 5 and 300 seconds.

source_create.title: Create producer instance
source_create.description: The Discovery Service validates the producer type and options. Enter options as a JSON object.

source_edit.title: Edit producer instance
source_edit.description: Producer type is fixed. The Discovery Service validates the updated options.

area_sources.title: Attach producer instance
area_sources.description: Area {area_name} currently has these producer instances attached: {attached}. Changes preserve all other associations.

error.control_token_required: A valid control token is required for changes. This integration is currently read-only.
error.revision_conflict: The configuration changed in the Discovery Service. Reopen Options and review the latest value before retrying.
error.invalid_auth: The Discovery Service rejected the configured token.
error.cannot_connect: The Discovery Service could not be reached.
error.invalid_request: The Discovery Service rejected this configuration. Check the producer options and try again.
error.invalid_json: Enter producer options as a valid JSON object.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole number from 5 to 300 seconds.
error.unknown: The configuration could not be saved.
